source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed line only adds a semicolon to assert_eq!(delta_link, expected_uri). The assertion still supplies no nonempty expected-result message, so it misses the current assertion-message guidance. Add a message such as: The returned delta-link URI should equal the expected URI. The case checks deserialization of a fixed terminal link, not a live pagination request or fresh test result.
title: The delta-link punctuation fix leaves its assertion without a message
